messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Users,
I have time series data. I am trying to calculate auto-correlation of the
data. My question is how can I calculate auto-corellation of the data and
decorrelation time?
Thanking you
With regards
Dulal Mondal

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
I'm assuming you are talking about vector data. For that, you can use
'timecorr' analysis command to calculate the spherical-harmonic time
correlation function, or just 'corr' to calculate straight
correlation. For regular scalar 1D data (like distances, energies,
etc) you would use the 'corr' analysis command. See the manual for
details.
-Dan
